प्लक्षद्वीप

PLAKṢADVĪPA . One of the seven dvīpas (islands). (See under Saptadvīpa.)

प्लक्षजाता

PLAKṢAJĀTĀ . A tributary of river gaṅgā. It is believed that this river is an incarnation of sarasvatī and that the sins of those who drink the water of this river will vanish. (Chapter 169, Ādi Parva).

प्लक्षप्रस्रवणतीर्थ

PLAKṢAPRASRAVAṆATĪRTHA . The place of origin of the river sarasvatī. This is a very holy place. (Śloka 11, Chapter 54, śalya Parva).

प्लक्षावतरण

PLAKṢĀVATARAṆA . A sacred spot at the place of origin of yamunā. The ancient people of bhārata used to worship this place as a gate of Heaven. (Śloka 4, Chapter 90, Vana Parva).

प्लक्षवती

PLAKṢAVATĪ . A river. This is referred to as a holy river in the Purāṇas. (Śloka 25, Chapter 165, Anuśāsana Parva).

प्लाक्षायन

PLĀKṢĀYANA . A Vaiyākaraṇa (grammarian). His opinion on Visargasandhi (a point in grammar) is described in Taittirīyaprātiśākhya.
